### Adonijah’s Treachery
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/adonijahs-treachery
Passage: 1 Kings 2:13-27
Points:
- Following David's death, Solomon acted decisively to confront internal threats to his royal authority.
- Adonijah revealed his lingering ambition for the throne by asking to marry David's concubine Abishag.
- Claiming a deceased king's concubine was understood in that culture as making a bid for the crown.
- Solomon recognized the treasonous scheme and executed Adonijah to protect the peace of the realm.
- Banishing Abiathar fulfilled the Lord's long-delayed prophetic judgment against the house of Eli.
- God's promised justice will unfailingly come to pass against all who oppose His righteous rule.
